attributes.residual: Unchanged: real 476, insns 1085/1087, opcode multiset DIFFERS ours-only -2 fmr, clusters at ours 0x998 and 0xf5c plus a net-zero `li` reorder pair at 0x50. The f32 `cand` plus f64 temp pair in the current source is confirmed correct by the target's own bytes.
